title: analysis_options.yaml with dart_code_linter
description: Generated from dart_code_linter 4.4.3. Only the DCL sections are strict; other analyzer settings are allowed as-is.

include.description: Options file(s) to include, e.g. package:dart_code_linter/presets/recommended.yaml

diagnostics.description: IDE / dart analyze: which DCL rules are on and at what severity.

always-remove-listener.description: Warns when a listener added with addListener is never removed in dispose. That can leak memory. (Flutter, default warning)

arguments-ordering.description: Named arguments must appear in the same order as the parameters are declared. (Dart, default style)

avoid-banned-imports.description: Blocks specific imports in specific files, e.g. no Flutter imports in your domain layer. Needs configuration. (Dart, default warning)

avoid-border-all.description: Use const Border.fromBorderSide(...) instead of Border.all(...), which can't be const. (Flutter, default performance)

avoid-cascade-after-if-null.description: Flags a ?? b..c. The cascade binds in a way that's easy to misread, so add parentheses. (Dart, default warning)

avoid-collection-methods-with-unrelated-.description: Catches calls like intList.contains('a') or map['key'] on Map<int, …>, where the types can never match. (Dart, default warning)

avoid-creating-vector-in-update.description: Don't allocate new Vector2 objects in update(), which runs every frame. Reuse one instead. (Flame, default warning)

avoid-double-slash-imports.description: Flags import paths that contain // by mistake. (Dart, default warning)

avoid-duplicate-exports.description: Flags the same file being exported twice. (Dart, default warning)

avoid-dynamic.description: Flags the dynamic type. Use a real type or Object? so the compiler can check your code. (Dart, default warning)

avoid-expanded-as-spacer.description: Use Spacer() instead of Expanded(child: SizedBox()) / Container(). (Flutter, default style)

avoid-global-state.description: Flags top-level or static variables that aren't final or const. Mutable globals make code hard to reason about and test. (Dart, default warning)

avoid-ignoring-return-values.description: Flags calls whose return value is thrown away, e.g. list.map(...) without using the result. (Dart, default warning)

avoid-initializing-in-on-mount.description: Don't initialize final late variables in onMount, which can run more than once. Use onLoad. (Flame, default warning)

avoid-late-keyword.description: Flags late variables, which can crash at runtime if read before being set. (Dart, default warning)

avoid-missing-enum-constant-in-map.description: A map literal keyed by an enum is missing one or more of the enum's values. (Dart, default warning)

avoid-nested-conditional-expressions.description: Flags deeply nested a ? b : c ? d : e chains. (Dart, default style)

avoid-non-ascii-symbols.description: Flags non-ASCII characters in string literals, which can be invisible or look-alike characters. (Dart, default warning)

avoid-non-configurable-callbacks-in-init.description: Flags callbacks set up in initState that never use the widget's fields, so users of the widget can't customize them. Make them constructor parameters. (Flutter, default warning)

avoid-non-exhaustive-switch-on-sealed-cl.description: Flags a default / _ case in a switch over a sealed type. It hides missing subtypes that the compiler would otherwise catch. (Dart, default style)

avoid-non-null-assertion.description: Flags the ! operator, which throws when the value is null. Prefer null checks or ??. (Dart, default warning)

avoid-passing-async-when-sync-expected.description: Flags an async function passed where a sync callback is expected. Its Future would be silently ignored. (Dart, default warning)

avoid-redundant-async.description: Flags functions marked async that never use await. (Dart, default warning)

avoid-redundant-async-on-load.description: Flags Flame onLoad marked async without any await. (Flame, default warning)

avoid-returning-widgets.description: Flags methods and functions that return widgets. Extract a widget class instead so Flutter can optimize rebuilds. (Flutter, default warning)

avoid-shrink-wrap-in-lists.description: Flags ListView(shrinkWrap: true), which lays out every child. Use slivers instead. (Flutter, default performance)

avoid-substring.description: substring can split emojis and other multi-unit characters. Use characters.getRange. (Dart, default warning)

avoid-throw-in-catch-block.description: Throwing a new error inside catch loses the original stack trace. Use rethrow or Error.throwWithStackTrace. (Dart, default warning)

avoid-top-level-members-in-tests.description: Flags public top-level declarations in test files. (Dart, default warning)

avoid-unnecessary-conditionals.description: Flags conditionals that always pick the same result, e.g. x ? true : false. (Dart, default warning)

avoid-unnecessary-setstate.description: Flags setState inside initState / didUpdateWidget / build, or wrapped around sync method calls, where it's not needed. (Flutter, default warning)

avoid-unnecessary-type-assertions.description: Flags is checks that are always true, e.g. a String checked with is String. (Dart, default warning)

avoid-unnecessary-type-casts.description: Flags as casts to a type the value already has. (Dart, default warning)

avoid-unrelated-type-assertions.description: Flags is checks that can never be true, e.g. an int checked with is String. (Dart, default warning)

avoid-unused-parameters.description: Flags function parameters that are never used. Name them _ to opt out. (Dart, default warning)

avoid-wrapping-in-padding.description: Don't wrap a Container in Padding. Use the Container's own padding property. (Flutter, default warning)

ban-name.description: Bans specific identifiers, such as functions or classes you don't want used. Needs configuration. (Dart, default warning)

binary-expression-operand-order.description: Prefer the literal on the right: x == 1 rather than 1 == x. (Dart, default style)

check-for-equals-in-render-object-setter.description: RenderObject setters should return early if the new value equals the old one, so they don't trigger needless layouts. (Flutter, default warning)

consistent-update-render-object.description: updateRenderObject should set the same fields that createRenderObject sets. (Flutter, default warning)

correct-game-instantiating.description: Flags a FlameGame created inside build(). It resets on every rebuild. (Flame, default warning)

double-literal-format.description: Consistent double literals: no leading zeros (01.2), no bare decimal point (.5 → 0.5), no trailing zeros (1.50). (Dart, default style)

format-comment.description: Comments should read like sentences: a space after //, a capital first letter and a final period. (Dart, default style)

list-all-equatable-fields.description: For Equatable classes, every field should be listed in props, or equality silently ignores it. (Dart, default warning)

member-ordering.description: Enforces the order of class members (constructors, fields, methods…). (Dart, default style)

missing-test-assertion.description: Flags test() bodies that contain no expect or other assertion. (Dart, default warning)

newline-before-return.description: Requires a blank line before return, unless the return is the first statement in its block. (Dart, default style)

no-blank-line-before-single-return.description: The opposite case: no blank line before a return that's the only statement in a block. (Dart, default style)

no-boolean-literal-compare.description: Write if (done) instead of if (done == true). (Dart, default style)

no-empty-block.description: Flags empty {} blocks, which are often missing code. A comment inside counts as content. (Dart, default style)

no-equal-arguments.description: Flags the same argument passed twice, e.g. Point(x, x), which is often a copy-paste bug. (Dart, default warning)

no-equal-then-else.description: Flags if/else or ?: where both branches do the same thing. (Dart, default warning)

no-magic-number.description: Flags unexplained number literals. Move them into named constants. (Dart, default warning)

no-object-declaration.description: Flags class members typed as Object. Use a more specific type. (Dart, default style)

only-barrel-import.description: Other packages must be imported through their main file (package:x/x.dart), not through internal files. (Dart, default error)

prefer-async-await.description: Use async/await instead of .then() chains. (Dart, default style)

prefer-commenting-analyzer-ignores.description: Every // ignore: comment should explain why it's there. (Dart, default style)

prefer-conditional-expressions.description: Turn a simple if/else that assigns or returns into a ?: expression. (Dart, default style)

prefer-const-border-radius.description: Use const BorderRadius.all(...) instead of BorderRadius.circular(...). (Flutter, default performance)

prefer-correct-edge-insets-constructor.description: Use the simplest EdgeInsets constructor, e.g. EdgeInsets.all(8) instead of fromLTRB(8, 8, 8, 8). (Flutter, default style)

prefer-correct-identifier-length.description: Variable and parameter names must be neither too short nor too long. (Dart, default style)

prefer-correct-test-file-name.description: Files containing tests must end with the test suffix. (Dart, default warning)

prefer-correct-type-name.description: Class, enum and typedef names must start with a capital letter and be a sensible length. (Dart, default style)

prefer-define-hero-tag.description: Give Hero-using widgets such as FloatingActionButton an explicit heroTag, to avoid duplicate-tag crashes. (Flutter, default warning)

prefer-dot-shorthands.description: Use Dart's dot shorthand (.center) when the type is already known from context. (Dart, default style)

prefer-enums-by-name.description: Use MyEnum.values.byName('x') instead of firstWhere on the name. (Dart, default style)

prefer-extracting-callbacks.description: Long inline callbacks in build() should be moved into methods. (Flutter, default style)

prefer-first.description: Use list.first instead of list[0] or elementAt(0). (Dart, default style)

prefer-first-or-null.description: Use firstOrNull instead of [0] / first when the list might be empty. (Dart, default style)

prefer-immediate-return.description: Return the expression directly instead of storing it in a variable and then returning that variable. (Dart, default style)

prefer-intl-name.description: The name: of Intl.message must match ClassName_memberName. (Intl, default warning)

prefer-iterable-of.description: Use List.of(x) instead of List.from(x). It keeps type checking. (Dart, default warning)

prefer-last.description: Use list.last instead of list[list.length - 1]. (Dart, default style)

prefer-match-file-name.description: The first class in a file should match the file name (UserRepo → user_repo.dart). (Dart, default warning)

prefer-media-query-direct-access.description: Use MediaQuery.sizeOf(context) instead of MediaQuery.of(context).size, so the widget only rebuilds when that one value changes. (Flutter, default performance)

prefer-moving-to-variable.description: Flags the same call chain repeated in one block. Store it in a variable. (Dart, default warning)

prefer-named-record-fields.description: Use named record fields ({int age}) instead of positional ones ((int,)) for readability. (Dart, default style)

prefer-provide-intl-description.description: Intl.message calls should include a desc: for translators. (Intl, default warning)

prefer-single-quotes.description: Use 'single' quotes instead of "double" for strings. (Dart, default style)

prefer-single-widget-per-file.description: Only one public widget per file. (Flutter, default style)

prefer-static-class.description: Put top-level functions, variables and constants into a class as static members. (Dart, default style)

prefer-trailing-comma.description: Add trailing commas to multi-line argument and parameter lists so dart format lays them out nicely. (Dart, default style)

prefer-using-list-view.description: Use ListView instead of SingleChildScrollView + Column. (Flutter, default performance)

provide-correct-intl-args.description: Intl.message args: must match the method's parameters and the placeholders in the text. (Intl, default warning)

tag-name.description: A static tag field (e.g. for logging) must match the class name. (Dart, default warning)

use-design-system-item.description: Suggests your design-system widget instead of a raw Flutter widget. Needs configuration. (Flutter, default warning)

use-setstate-synchronously.description: Flags setState after an await without a mounted check. It crashes if the widget was disposed meanwhile. (Flutter, default warning)

metrics.description: Metric thresholds for the command-line tool.

cyclomatic-complexity.description: Number of independent paths through a function (each if, loop, case, && or || adds one). High means hard to test. Applies to functions. Default 20 (max).

halstead-volume.description: Size of a function based on how many operators and operands it uses. Applies to functions. Default 150 (max).

lines-of-code.description: All lines in a function, including blank lines and comments. Applies to functions. Default 100 (max).

source-lines-of-code.description: Lines that contain code, ignoring blank lines and comments. Applies to functions. Default 50 (max).

maximum-nesting-level.description: Deepest block nesting (if inside for inside if…). Applies to functions. Default 5 (max).

number-of-parameters.description: How many parameters a function takes. Applies to functions. Default 4 (max).

maintainability-index.description: 0–100 score combining complexity, volume and size. Higher is better. Applies to functions. Default 50 (min).

number-of-methods.description: How many methods a class has. Applies to classes. Default 10 (max).

weight-of-class.description: Share of a class's public members that are real behavior rather than getters and setters (0–1). Applies to classes. Default 0.33 (min).

technical-debt.description: Estimated cost to fix TODOs, ignores, casts and similar debt markers. Applies to files. Default 0 (off).
